name: Twincity Marathon 2027
short_description: Twincity Marathon 2027 is a full-marathon event held in Cyberjaya, Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia on January 24, 2027.
ai_summary: Twincity Marathon 2027 is a full-marathon event scheduled for January 24, 2027, in Cyberjaya, Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia. The race offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.098km, 12km, and 5km, catering to a range of runners from beginners to marathon veterans. Registration details have not yet been announced. The event is set within the planned city of Cyberjaya, in Selangor state.
pros: Eight-hour marathon cut-off suits slower runners
Race-morning air of 24-25°C from the 2.45am start to 8.30am in 2026
Route crosses both Putrajaya and Cyberjaya from a Dataran Putrajaya start
Cash prizes three deep and trophies to 10th in Malaysian open and veteran categories
Half marathon, 12 km, 5 km and Saturday 10 km and 3 km for non-marathoners
cons: Very early starts: 2.45am marathon in 2026, 2.30am in 2027
Crowded start: one half marathoner took over ten minutes to cross the start line
Only partial road closures on parts of the Cyberjaya section
Entries were non-refundable and non-transferable in 2026

faqs.question: When does the Twincity Marathon 2027 take place?
faqs.answer: The Twincity Marathon 2027 is scheduled to take place on January 24, 2027. The event will be held in Cyberjaya, Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia, offering runners a full range of distance options to choose from on that specific date.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Twincity Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: The Twincity Marathon 2027 offers four distance categories for participants: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.098km, a 12km run, and a shorter 5km option, catering to varying levels of runner experience and fitness.

faqs.question: Where is the Twincity Marathon 2027 held?
faqs.answer: The Twincity Marathon 2027 is held in Cyberjaya, located in Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia. Cyberjaya serves as the venue and city for this event, providing the setting for all four race distances offered to participants during the 2027 edition.
